rows.oneLine: FrontStrike competitive gaming product with a verified Solana devnet program.
rows.whatItBuilds: PrimeSkill Studio developed FrontStrike, a competitive gaming product using a Solana devnet program and a devnet test token.
rows.finding: Mainnet deployment was not verified and the official X account was suspended when checked. The devnet program recorded 443 signatures with a 91.87% success rate; its latest observed activity was 20 September 2025.
rows.nextAction: Founder verification is required to confirm whether FrontStrike migrated, paused or was abandoned.

rows.oneLine: Climate-data infrastructure with live SST dashboards and a pre-mainnet Solana layer.
rows.whatItBuilds: END Corp operates public sea-surface-temperature data products and is developing decentralised satellite ground-station and token infrastructure.
rows.finding: The public climate dashboard is live and updated daily. All verified END Corp program and token addresses were on Solana devnet; no known mainnet address was found.
rows.nextAction: Validate the devnet findings with the founder and request a production deployment address when mainnet launches.

rows.oneLine: A consumer and DePIN concept with insufficient public product or chain evidence.
rows.whatItBuilds: The directory positions Home Harvest across consumer and DePIN, but the available public presence did not provide enough material to validate a live product or blockchain deployment.
rows.finding: The reviewed X page contained no usable product evidence. No verified mainnet deployment, public contract or measurable user activity was identified.
rows.nextAction: Ask the founder for the product URL, current build status, user metrics and any devnet or mainnet deployment.

rows.oneLine: A short-form playable-game feed that supported a large no-code game jam.
rows.whatItBuilds: Scrolly was a feed for instantly playable games, shared points, leaderboards and developer distribution. The founder confirmed that activity and Coinflow payments were off-chain.
rows.finding: No official token or public Scrolly program was verified. Public records support 300 submissions as a project-reported count, while 27 games and 25 developers were individually named in the public census. Production ended on 26 June 2026.
rows.nextAction: Retain as a historical ecosystem-support case study and keep platform-wide claims separate from named developer evidence.

rows.oneLine: Fanplay evolved into WTF Games after moving its crypto-payment rails to Solana.
rows.whatItBuilds: Fanplay launched live-event wagering using USDC, first on Arbitrum and later on Solana, before evolving into the WTF Games crypto-casino brand.
rows.finding: Mainnet use is supported by official migration and product evidence, but no operational wallet, treasury, vault, program ID or verified transaction has been publicly documented. Public evidence indicates a hybrid model where crypto payments may be on-chain while wagering logic remains internal.
rows.nextAction: Identify one legitimate deposit, withdrawal or bet transaction, verify the receiving entity and expand it into an operational-wallet cluster.

rows.oneLine: A Solana crowdfunding platform for narrative, entertainment and startup projects that has since wound down.
rows.whatItBuilds: Fundl provided crowdfunding and crowd-investing infrastructure for creators developing stories, books, comics, games, animation and startups.
rows.finding: Fundl’s public terms and product material support the use of SOL and USDC transactions on Solana through wallet integrations including Privy, Phantom and Solflare. However, no publicly attributable custom program, campaign vault, treasury, operational wallet or verified Fundl transaction entry point was identified during the first pass. The directory classifies the project as wound down.
rows.nextAction: Discover or obtain a historical Fundl transaction, campaign wallet, treasury, vault or program address, confirm its attribution, and use it to reconstruct historical users, contributions and USDC/SOL volume.

relatedPeople: Andre Peter Phillip — legal director of Moon Boi Studios Ltd
rows.oneLine: Moon Boi Studios is developing Moon Boi Universe, a playable cyber-fantasy RPG with claimed Solana and Seeker integration.
rows.whatItBuilds: Moon Boi Universe is a 2.5D story-driven cyber-fantasy RPG available through public prototype and application listings. The project has promoted Solana-powered ownership, NFT functionality and Solana Mobile/Seeker integration. DD Gaming is a related gaming venture involving Ems and Dean Ball, but it must not be treated as identical to Moon Boi Universe or Scrolly.
rows.finding: A playable product and continuing game-development activity were publicly observed. Moon Boi Studios Ltd is an active UK company incorporated in 2022. However, no official mainnet program, operational wallet, NFT collection address, marketplace address or token mint was verified. Product availability must not be presented as proof of mainnet activity.
rows.nextAction: Locate an officially attributable Moon Boi Universe mainnet transaction, program, NFT collection, marketplace or operational wallet. If none is publicly available, retain the project as playable with unverified Solana integration.
completedAnalysis: Solana and Seeker integration claims documented
outstandingAnalysis: Whether Solana integration is live on mainnet

rows.oneLine: A non-custodial on-chain sports-betting aggregator whose website currently reports that the platform is hibernating.
rows.whatItBuilds: Purebet aggregated odds and liquidity from on-chain betting venues. Historical product material states that users placed bets using Solana-native USDC, with settlement and winnings processed through on-chain exchange architecture.
rows.finding: The current Purebet website states that the platform is hibernating. A mainnet executable program labelled publicly as the Purebet Program was discovered at 39mBcnQ27QA9nNZmM6VrumE2vtqs5v3HD7t7RGv9kXUV. Direct Solana RPC validation confirmed that it is executable and linked to program-data account 7Z3XMqoZfjom2CArncLmqSbhQVB5vKfApxdCt8qoyW4Q. The public RPC returned at least 3,000 program signatures before archival retrieval failed: 2,788 successful and 212 failed, producing a preliminary 92.93% success rate. The retrieved activity interval reached from 6 March 2024 to 8 January 2025. The 3,000 signatures are a lower bound, not a lifetime total.
rows.nextAction: Confirm the program attribution using an official source or founder response, retrieve its complete archival history, decode program instructions and calculate users, betting volume, payouts, retention and market-making concentration.

rows.oneLine: A live digital marketplace connecting agricultural producers and international buyers.
rows.whatItBuilds: AgriDex is a live digital marketplace connecting agricultural producers and international buyers.
rows.finding: Its official website reports 34 markets, 22 currencies and indicative settlement of two to four hours. It also reports throughput equivalent to 100,000 tonnes of wheat, 20 million litres of olive oil and 45,000 tonnes of sugar. These are project-reported figures.
rows.evidenceBoundary: Public materials indicate settlement may involve stablecoins and Solana, but no official program, settlement wallet, vault or transaction entry point has been verified.
rows.nextAction: Obtain one officially attributable settlement transaction, program, treasury or operational wallet before calculating users, transactions, stablecoin volume or corridor activity.
completedAnalysis: Official marketplace and settlement claims documented
outstandingAnalysis: Users, transactions, stablecoin volume and corridor activity

rows.oneLine: Continuous Web3 security tooling combining automated analysis and expert-led smart-contract audits.
rows.whatItBuilds: Fidesium provides continuous Web3 security tooling combining automated analysis and expert-led smart-contract audits.
rows.finding: The official website identifies Greg Bock as co-founder and CEO and Abraham Polishchuk as co-founder and CTO. Fidesium analyzes blockchain systems, but no Fidesium-owned protocol program or operational wallet was found.
rows.evidenceBoundary: Analyzing blockchain data does not create an attributable Fidesium protocol footprint.
rows.nextAction: Track customer adoption, published audits and supported-chain coverage using off-chain or company-supplied metrics.

rows.oneLine: A no-app loyalty system in which customers tap NFC cards, collect stamps and redeem rewards.
rows.whatItBuilds: IRLS is a no-app loyalty system in which customers tap NFC cards, collect stamps and redeem rewards.
rows.finding: The official website advertises plans from £5 per month, unlimited users, a live customer-activity dashboard and nine visible customer or partner names.
rows.evidenceBoundary: No official program, mint, wallet or other attributable on-chain entry point was found.
rows.nextAction: Request active merchant count, registered customers, NFC taps, redemptions and retention from the product team.
completedAnalysis: Official pricing and visible customer or partner claims documented

rows.productStatus: Initial hardware run sold out and shipped
rows.technicalStatus: Solana-native wallet infrastructure; no project-specific protocol identified
rows.oneLine: An open-source Solana-native hardware wallet and companion application.
rows.whatItBuilds: Unruggable is an open-source Solana-native hardware wallet and companion application.
rows.finding: The official website reports that its initial run sold out and all orders shipped in Q2. Solana’s official account described it as an open-source Solana-native hardware wallet.
rows.evidenceBoundary: Transactions signed through the wallet must not automatically be attributed as Unruggable protocol activity.
rows.nextAction: Track devices sold, activated devices and application users. Add it to the mainnet queue only if an attributable Unruggable contract, program or operational address is published.

rows.oneLine: Compliance automation for UK and EU startups pursuing ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, the EU AI Act and ISO 42001.
rows.whatItBuilds: Kantis provides compliance automation for UK and EU startups pursuing ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, the EU AI Act and ISO 42001.
rows.finding: The official website and terms identify We Make Tech Ltd as the company trading as Kantis. An official customer case reports ISO 27001 certification in six weeks with zero non-conformities. These are project-reported case-study results.
rows.evidenceBoundary: No blockchain product or attributable on-chain entry point was found.
rows.nextAction: Track verified customers, completed certifications, time to certification, integrations and retention using company-supplied off-chain records.
